product.name: On-Demand Warehouse Booking Platform
product.description: An online platform that allows customers to search, select, and book warehouse space and related services based on criteria like size, location, budget, and duration.

product.name: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
product.description: A web-based warehouse management system that supports inventory tracking, barcode scanning, and real-time updates for consignments stored in partner warehouses.

product.name: Logistics and Transport Services
product.description: Additional service allowing customers to book transport for picking up and moving inventory to and from warehouses, with options based on distance, goods nature, weight, and dimensions.

product.name: Inventory Insurance Arrangement
product.description: A service to arrange insurance options for goods stored in warehouses, allowing customers to select appropriate coverage plans.

product.name: Warehouse Partner Onboarding and Support
product.description: A service for warehouse owners to list their facilities on ODWEN’s platform, including site inspections, WMS provision, and operational training.
